title: clintonia uniflora
intro: Clintonia uniflora, commonly known as the yellow clintonia or starflower, is a perennial plant belonging to the lily family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Clintonia uniflora include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating various conditions such as arthritis and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
